issues.issue: AI explanations are too dense during fast play
issues.evidence: P1: too much info; P2: small AI text; P3: too many words; P5: slightly wordy.
issues.change: Show action, target and one short reason by default. Put algorithm details behind an optional expandable section.
issues.status: Implemented in standalone UI prototype; game integration and retest pending
issues.check: A new player explains one decision without opening advanced details.

issues.issue: Predictions feel like guesses or disconnected text
issues.evidence: P1: felt like it was guessing; P2: random guess after quick changes; P3: random text, hard to link to the boss.
issues.change: Label a prediction as a forecast. Keep target, rationale, forecast percentage and observed result together.
issues.status: Implemented in standalone UI prototype; game integration and retest pending
issues.check: Players distinguish a forecast from a guaranteed hit and can find the observed result.

issues.issue: Opponent information is slow to locate
issues.evidence: P2 checked hero status first; P3 scanned many UI elements; P5 searched central graphics before the side panel.
issues.change: Use a single Opponent plan heading, compact lane highlights and clearer information hierarchy.
issues.status: Implemented in standalone UI prototype; game integration and retest pending
issues.check: Locate and identify the opponent plan before starting a round.

issues.evidence: P3 stared at the error before recognizing the recovery action; recovery took 14 seconds.
issues.change: Keep one prominent retry action and ensure disabled start text matches the failure state.
issues.status: Implemented in standalone UI prototype; game integration and retest pending
issues.check: Recover from a forced preparation failure without assistance.

caveats: P1 T2 and T3 times and outcomes are missing. They are excluded from the corresponding denominators, not treated as zero or failure.
P3 T3 outcome is reported as Yes but its notes say prompting was needed. Reported completion is not proof of independent success.
All five session dates are missing and tested versions are unconfirmed. Difficulty consistency and device equivalence are not established.
P2 structured gaming frequency is 3-4 times weekly; the raw note says daily. Both are preserved.
T4 ease was supplied for P2-P5 but not P1. It is supplementary and must not be described as a consistently administered measure.
P1 protocol and error setup evolved during the session. P1 recovery timing boundaries were not separately confirmed.
User-supplied records are analyzed as provided. The earlier SIM01-SIM06 examples and unrelated P04 fragment are excluded.
